name: hcapp_setFcmTokens
description: Updates the push notification tokens (APNS and/or FCM) for a registered device. Called when the OS issues a new push token to the app.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID. Used to look up the caller and to target the UPDATE.

parameters.name: apnsToken
parameters.description: Apple Push Notification Service token. NULL for Android.

rowsets.name: NullUserError
rowsets.description: Returned when userId from Device lookup is null or the null UUID. Standard error format.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 fails. Standard error format. Notably uses errorType=3 (correct).

rowsets.name: UpdateResult
rowsets.description: Returned on successful auth. Single row with the update outcome.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Device SET ApnsToken, FcmToken WHERE id = @deviceId
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on null-user and auth-failure paths

codeSmells.detail: 'Success' or 'Failed' in the result column. Caller must parse the string to detect failure — should be a standard success/error rowset.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the 'Success'/'Failed' string values without updating all callers
